messages.author: 70fa05bacce54f4f
messages.subject: bootstrapLavaan with covariance matrix
parts:
Hi everyone!  I am wondering if anyone knows how to use bootstrapLavaan if you want to incorporate a new variance/covar matrix?

For instance, if I specify a covariance matrix in some sample data:

set.seed(5)
X <- matrix(rnorm(200), ncol = 4)

X <- data.frame(X)
names(X) <- c("A", "B", "C", "D")

model <- '
A ~ B + C + D
B ~ C + D'

fitB <- cfa(model, sample.cov = cov(X), sample.nobs = nrow(X),
            fixed.x = FALSE, se="none")
orig <- fitMeasures(fitB, "chisq")
chisq.boot <- bootstrapLavaan(fitB, FUN=fitMeasures, R=100,
                              type="bollen.stine",
                              verbose=TRUE,
                              fit.measures="chisq")

I keep getting the error "Error in data@X[[g]] : subscript out of bounds", in the sample data and my own dataset.  Does anyone have any ideas about what might be going on?

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: bootstrapLavaan with covariance matrix
parts:
I am afraid that the Bollen-Stine bootstrap approach require raw data. Otherwise the data transformation is impossible. Parametric bootstrap, on the other hand, should work.
